description:
## Problem
Snowflake ships tuned templates only for TPC-H and TPC-DS. They are generated by `scripts/generate_cloud_tpc_templates.py` (`PLATFORMS = ("snowflake",)`, `BENCHMARKS = ("tpch", "tpcds")`, lines 57-58), mirrored in `benchbox/core/tuning/templates/snowflake/` and `examples/tunings/snowflake/`, and pinned by tests: fact tables only, at most 3 clustering columns, logical-profile certification (`tests/unit/core/tuning/test_snowflake_tuned_template_clustering.py`, `test_tpc_tuning_template_parity.py:355-415`).

A hand-written SSB draft used for a 2026-10-12 pilot clustered every dimension table by its surrogate key and put four columns on LINEORDER. It broke these rules and was not shipped. Tuned SSB runs on Snowflake therefore have no valid template.

## Change
- Extend the generator to SSB for Snowflake: LINEORDER only, date key first, at most 3 columns, ranked by the existing `snowflake_cluster_rank`.
- Write both template trees.
- Add `snowflake: ssb` to `benchbox/core/tuning/profiles/template_evidence.yaml` with no measurements.
- Extend the Snowflake template tests to include SSB.
